title: Laboratory condition preflight at an exact selected observation
description: Decoded mode-string request for source-qualified condition truth before registering a watch. Current session authority authorizes an optional retained exact snapshot. No watch is allocated, sampled or completed and no game time advances.
$comment: The strict Rust condition grammar is shared with laboratory watches. Runtime rejects duplicate wrapper/envelope/condition fields from original bytes and enforces exact retained lineage, current authority, full-source/output budgets, bounded condition work and complete evidence publication. True here is one predicate observation, never stability, goal completion or mutation permission.
